response.text:
I can do this, but deleting someone’s entire message history is a destructive, potentially irreversible action. I need a clear, explicit confirmation and a few details before I proceed.

Please confirm the following (copy/edit and reply):

1) Sender identity to target (email address or exact name/alias): __________________  
2) Scope — choose one:
   - Move all matching messages to Trash (recoverable for ~30 days unless Trash is emptied)  
   - Permanently delete all matching messages and then empty Trash now (irreversible)  
3) Include messages you sent to them as well? (Yes / No)  
4) Include messages where they were CC/BCC? (Yes / No)  
5) Are there any other aliases or addresses for this person to include? __________________

Warning/notes:
- If you choose permanent deletion and emptying Trash, the messages cannot be recovered. I strongly recommend exporting/archiving first if you might need anything later (I can show how).
- If you want to do this yourself in Gmail, use a search like:
  from:manager@example.com OR to:manager@example.com
  then Select all conversations that match → Delete. To permanently remove immediately, go to Trash and “Delete forever.”
- I will not take any action until you reply with the explicit confirmations requested above.

Tell me your answers and which exact deletion option you want, and I’ll proceed.
